'''Enervation''' is a [[debuff]] that reduces [[movement speed]] of the character by 20% and disables [[life]] and [[energy shield]] recovery. The debuff does not stack and lasts for 4 seconds. 

==Sources==
* [[Ward Shatter]] (skill from [[Volatile Runes]] in [[Olroth Bloodline]])
* [[Olroth, Origin of the Fall]] applies with the aftershock pulses from his Ground Slam skill.
